addendum_content_raw:
In my 2010 Financial Disclosure Report, I identified AAPL Common Stock (Y) at lines 13 and 42 out of an abundance of caution because I could not recall or

locate documentation for the date on which I sold the stock. 1 have since located documentation indicating that the stock was sold in October 2009, before 1

became a judge and outside of the 2010 reporting period. 1 therefore have removed those entries from my current report. Similarly, I reported JAVA Common

Stock (Y) at line 51 in my 2010 Financial Disclosure Report, but the stock disappeared as a result of a reverse stock split in approximately September 2009

(shortly after Sun Microsystems was acquired by Oracle), before I became a judge and outside of the 2010 reporting period. 1 therefore have removed this entry

from my current report.
